iwlwifi_injection_limitation.finding: Intel iwlwifi driver does NOT support raw 802.11 frame injection in monitor mode
iwlwifi_injection_limitation.detail: scapy sendp() on monitor interface succeeds at kernel level but firmware silently drops frames
iwlwifi_injection_limitation.evidence: 0 beacons captured from Switch in full monitor mode (5s baseline), 0 in 10s post-injection
iwlwifi_injection_limitation.nl80211_result: ENOTCONN (errno 107) when waiting for ACK; silently queued when using DONT_WAIT_FOR_ACK

concurrent_monitor_mode.finding: Concurrent monitor+managed interface barely captures any frames
concurrent_monitor_mode.evidence: 1 frame in 5s on mon0 while wlp5s0 associated, vs expected 50+ beacons

nl80211_cmd_frame.finding: NL80211_CMD_FRAME returns ENOTCONN on managed interface for action frames to associated AP
nl80211_cmd_frame.detail: Likely requires additional attributes or frame format adjustment
nl80211_cmd_frame.without_ack_wait: Returns TX cookie (kernel queues) but frame may not be transmitted
nl80211_cmd_frame.with_ack_wait: Returns ENOTCONN (errno 107) — kernel rejects after checking association state
nl80211_cmd_frame.note: Some ENOTCONN tests were run after NetworkManager auto-switched to home WiFi

switch_lp2p_session.finding: lp2p AP disappeared after testing (Switch went to sleep or app closed)
switch_lp2p_session.note: Vulnerable IPC RecvActionFrame path requires a game actively polling for frames

requirements_for_success.wifi_adapter: Need adapter with ACTUAL injection support (ath9k, rtl8812au, etc.)
requirements_for_success.game_state: Switch must have a game in active lp2p multiplayer session (RecvActionFrame IPC pending)
requirements_for_success.alternative: If NL80211_CMD_FRAME can be fixed, iwlwifi may work for on-channel TX

frames_attempted.nl80211_no_ack: 1100 (various frame types) — queued but likely NOT transmitted
